observations.layout: 并列西石栏匠室与东木围护匠室，南侧门廊接东室，再经西向隔门进西室。两室砂轮/锻造台及两个箱分开，是一个低屋体。
observations.proportion: 13×7×10完整910位置，582air/328非空气；底部广石台与低檐主导，高度小于两平面边。无床、梯、炉或岩浆，不叫完整热锻坊。
observations.facade: 西界(2,1,4/5)为cobbled_deepslate_wall、其上iron_bars，区别封实石墙；东屋木框带玻璃窗。单格分类图不能当围栏碰撞或封窗证明。
observations.roof: dark_oak_slab56/dark_oak_stairs33构成并列两段宽檐屋盖与南门廊伸出；同作者旧W022一条长厅双坡顶，本例多段侧并组织不是家具换色。
observations.materials: stripped_spruce_wood46、cobbled_deepslate41、dark_oak_planks34；砂轮(5,1,5)south、smithing_table(9,1,3)，武器箱(4,2,3)south/工具箱(9,2,5)west。一发光物品框spyglass原实体留档未渲染，不冒充武器陈列/NPC。
observations.circulation: 南门(7,1,6)south进入东室，内门(6,1,4)west通西室；门廊与前石步连接socket final_state北向底阶。室内是否满足NPC路径/回避需原生验收，不能靠门坐标直接放行。
observations.terrain: 一体石台上两室、草木边缘与台阶整体完整，村民池不是房翼；无地面processor的单体不据此声称坡地适配。旧源内实体全局坐标保留但未进入用户世界。

written_case_actually_read.whole_boundary: Full volume states stored, whole/cutaway/layers/central sections actually viewed, only empty entrance/entity pools; no required spatial wing identified. Basegame missing dependencies retained, no runtime claim.

Current two side-by-side rooms with sequential door access, different enclosures and porch/roof organization. Compare059F02 main closed room+open annex: current west room is iron-bar bounded chamber, east wood enclosed chamber and south projecting porch, no enclosed/open main/shed substitution. No pure palette credit.

independent_findings: Visible whole/cut/ground diagrams show one ground-level two-room body and a long shared outdoor forecourt with a small canopy; not multiple buildings, workshops or usable upper storeys.

Actual selected original states confirm two real bed pairs, east outer door and south internal door, outdoor composter and stonecutter. Inner southern doorway3,1,6 retains an old blank wall sign, not all-air passage; no native collision or path proven.

Work is outside; interiors are mainly two serial sleeping rooms. This can inform private/public zoning, but applicable smithy-design distinctness is insufficiently established beyond prior060F02 serial rooms through a forecourt and061F01 ground work/home/canopy forecourt. Moving a second bed/partition or changing trade labels does not automatically create a newly credited complete workshop design.

082F02 likewise preserves detailed study while adding no family credit for room plus outdoor work pad. This is a bounded hold for the present evidence, not a universal equivalence claim or denial of possible later substantive whole-layout evidence.
